generations.name: First generation (PPE)
generations.notes: Launch on PPE (shared with Macan Electric), 800 V. Main pack 100 kWh gross / 94.9 kWh usable, up to 270 kW DC (Q6, SQ6, Sportbacks). EPA also rates a RWD "Q6 e-tron" and "ultra"; check per variant whether any uses the smaller 83 kWh / 75.8 kWh pack (225 kW) sold in Europe. Sportback is a body variant on the same hardware. Confidence: medium-high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Audi_Q6_e-tron
